subject: DONE s323: `use` inside a do{}/eval{} block was silently dropped under v2 (+ imported into the wrong package)
description:
FIXED s323.  Two defects in one family, found while triaging the widened CPAN board (#183): 9 Class-Method-Modifiers t-files died "The function Class::pl-before is undefined" from the everyday shape `do { package Class; use Class::Method::Modifiers; ... }`.

1. SILENT DROP (v2 only).  v1's parse_block_as_function HOISTS a use/BEGIN/`our` out of an expression block into the `definitions` bucket.  When the current bucket already IS `definitions` it takes a DEFERRAL path (`_pending_hoisted_defs`), flushed by `_process_children` once the enclosing top-level statement finishes.  Under v2 that parser is only the expression SEAM — nothing ever calls `_process_children`, so the buffer was never flushed and the `use` vanished from the output entirely.  Fix: skip the deferral when the parser has a `_v2_owner`; the plain push into the (scratch, freshly-opened) section is then picked up by `_lower_expr`'s existing drain, and an analysis-only parse throws it away as it already does.  New: `Pl::Parser2::_build_fallback_parser` sets a WEAK `_v2_owner` back-reference.

2. WRONG IMPORT PACKAGE (both pipelines).  `p-use` imported into `*package*`, which is right only because a top-level `package Foo;` opens its own CL section.  A `package` inside a do/eval block is only a RUNTIME switch, so a hoisted use imported into the enclosing package.  Fix: `p-use` takes `:into "Perl::Pkg"`, and the codegen emits it when `_block_depth > 0` (bumped exactly for blocks carrying a package statement, so no other emission changes).

Guard: Pl/t/transpile-test-09.t "`use` inside a do/eval block is not dropped (#187)" — 6 rows incl. the inverse guards (no leak into main, main-level do still imports, the do-block keeps its value, eval{} takes the same path).

Verified: Class-Method-Modifiers 000-load.t passes; corpus emission unchanged.
activeForm: Fixing dropped use in expression blocks
